title: Page heading of Schedules, where a person sees their recurring work and jobs.
description: Text under the heading. A socio is an AI agent (product noun); a job is code a socio saved that runs in its computer (a sandbox) without the AI model.
load-failed: Error toast when the schedules could not be loaded.
tabs.label: Accessible name of the page's tab list.
tabs.schedules: Tab on the Schedules page with the person's goals and schedules.
tabs.jobs: Tab on the Schedules page with the jobs (code a socio saved) the person's socios run.
tabs.workspace: Tab, for admins only: counts for everyone in the workspace.
goals.title: Card heading on the Schedules tab over the goals the person's socios work toward.
goals.description: Description of the Goals card: what socios keep working toward for the person.
goals.some-socio: Stands in for a socio's name when the goal's socio isn't known.
goals.line: Line under a goal's title: {{socio}} is the socio's name, {{cadence}} how often it runs (as stored, e.g. "every weekday at 09:00"), {{progress}} the socio's latest progress note in its own words. Variants: no schedule, no progress yet, or neither.
schedules.title: Card heading over the table of the person's schedules.
schedules.usage: Card description: how many schedules are active against the limit, and the shortest interval allowed between runs.
schedules.empty: Shown when the person has no schedules. The clock button is in a conversation's composer.
schedules.find: Accessible name of the toolbar with search and filters.
schedules.search: Accessible name and placeholder of the search box.
schedules.status-filter: Accessible name of the status filter.
schedules.status-any: The status filter's option for no filter.
schedules.socio-filter: Accessible name of the socio filter.
schedules.socio-any: The socio filter's option for no filter.
schedules.no-match: Shown when the search and filters match no schedule.
schedules.grid: Accessible name of the schedules table.
schedules.columns.title: Column heading: the schedule's title, with its socio and what it runs.
schedules.columns.status: Column heading: the schedule's status badge.
schedules.columns.cadence: Column heading: how often the schedule runs.
schedules.columns.next: Column heading: when the schedule runs next.
schedules.columns.last: Column heading: when the schedule last ran and how that run went.
schedules.columns.goal: Column heading: the goal the schedule works toward, if it has one.
schedules.next: Label before the next run's time, on a schedule's card on small screens.
schedules.last: Label before the last run, on a schedule's card on small screens.
schedules.goal: Label before the goal the schedule works on, on its card on small screens.
schedules.meta: Line under a schedule's title: {{socio}} the socio's name, {{job}} the job it runs (a name). The _mine forms add that the person made it themselves.
schedules.meta-deleted-job: Like the line above, when the job the schedule runs was deleted.
schedules.meta-turn: Like the line above, for a schedule that runs a socio turn (a conversation turn with the AI model).
schedules.cadence: A schedule's cadence as stored (e.g. "every weekday at 09:00") and, in parentheses, its time zone (an IANA name such as Europe/Madrid).
schedules.not-yet: In the Last run column: the schedule hasn't run yet.
schedules.open: Menu item that opens the schedule's page.
schedules.canceled: Disabled menu item: the schedule is canceled.
schedules.cancel: Menu item that opens the dialog to cancel the schedule.
jobs.title: Card heading on the Jobs tab over the table of the person's jobs.
jobs.description: Card description: {{timeout}} is the longest a run may take (e.g. "300 sec"); {{jobs}} and {{max}} count the person's jobs against the limit. A token is a credential made for one run.
jobs.empty: Shown when the person has no jobs.
jobs.columns.job: Column heading: the job's name, with its socio and entry file.
jobs.columns.version: Column heading: the job's current version number.
jobs.columns.timeout: Column heading: the longest one run of the job may take.
jobs.columns.last: Column heading: when the job last ran and how that run went.
jobs.columns.actions: Column heading over the row's buttons.
jobs.meta: Line under a job's name: {{socio}} the socio's name, {{entry}} its entry file (main.ts or main.sh, not to translate), and its file count. The until-done forms add that it runs in batches until its work is done.
jobs.version: A job's version number; v for version.
jobs.never: In the Last run column: the job never ran.
jobs.running: Disabled button while the job runs.
jobs.details: Button that opens the job's panel (versions, runs, logs).
jobs.hide: Button that closes the job's panel.
jobs.started: Toast after starting a job; {{name}} is its name. The until-done form: it runs in batches until done.
jobs.start-failed: Error toast when the job could not be started.
long-run.done: A long-running job's items: how many are done of all; the failed form adds how many failed.
long-run.empty: A long-running job has no items listed yet.
long-run.meter: Accessible name of the progress bar of a long-running job's items.
counts.title: Card heading on the admins' tab: everyone's schedules and jobs, as counts.
counts.description: Description of the card on the admins' Workspace tab: it shows only counts, not what each person's schedules and jobs do.
counts.schedules: {{counts}} lists counts by status, joined by dots ("3 scheduled · 1 paused").
counts.jobs: {{count}} is how many jobs are saved across the whole workspace.
counts.job-runs: {{counts}} lists the kept job runs' counts by status ("12 succeeded · 2 failed").
counts.running: {{count}} is how many job runs are going on right now across the workspace.
counts.status: One count in those lists: {{count}} and a status word (lowercase).
counts.none: In those lists: nothing to count.
